For Indian retail investors, trade tensions between the world's two largest economies carry major implications for global supply chains, commodity prices, and overall market sentiment. rows.headline: UIDAI extends free online Aadhaar document updates until June 14, 2027
rows.hook: No-cost document updates extended for three years
rows.summary: The Unique Identification Authority of India has extended the deadline for free online document updates on Aadhaar portals to June 14, 2027. Citizens can continue to update identity and address proofs without paying the standard fee online. However, biometric updates such as photographs, fingerprints, and iris details still require a visit to an authorized Aadhaar Enrolment or Update Centre. This extension benefits all resident cardholders seeking to keep their KYC records compliant without incurring charges. Retail investors and citizens can utilize this period to update their identity proofs for financial and banking compliance at zero cost.
rows.why_it_matters: Update your Aadhaar documents online for free before June 2027.

rows.headline: US DLA commits $2 billion to acquire critical materials for National Defense Stockpile
rows.hook: Pentagon backs domestic critical minerals supply chain

For Indian retail investors, shifts in US critical mineral sourcing can impact global commodity prices and trade flows. rows.why_it_matters: Global critical mineral price trends could shift over time.
rows.winners_losers: US domestic producers gain / foreign suppliers face shifting demand
